🐦 Twitter Sentiment Analysis (bdstar/twitter-sentiment-analysis)
	


	
		
	
	
		🧠 Overview
	

A refined and merged version of Twitter text sentiment datasets, providing a clean and well-balanced dataset for sentiment classification across three sentiment categories:positive, negative, and neutral.
This dataset is split into three parts — train, test, and validation — each sourced from highly reputable open datasets.It is designed for training, evaluating, and benchmarking NLP… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bdstar/twitter-sentiment-analysis.
